arxiv-1511-08388.title: Electromagnetic cloaking in convex and concave media with surface modelled as a parameterised function
arxiv-1511-08388.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by . The onset of transformation optics has opened avenues for designing of a plenitude of applications related to propagation of electromagnetic waves in anisotropic media. In this paper, an algorithm is proposed using a coordinate transformation and a piecewise function for the purpose of designing a three dimensional cloak having an arbitrary geometry which could be convex or non-convex in nature. The surfaces of the cloak as well as of the body under consideration are assumed to be conformal to each other .

arxiv-1904-01572.title: Time-Dependent Two-Fluid Magnetohydrodynamic Model and Simulation of the chromosphere
arxiv-1904-01572.creator: Qusai Al Shidi, Ofer Cohen, Paul Song, Jiannan Tu
arxiv-1904-01572.description: Abstract keywords chromosphere, Models; Jets \setlastpage \inarticletrue {opening} 1 Introduction The base of the outer solar atmosphere (right above the photosphere), referred to as the chromosphere, is highly dynamic and is strongly influenced by magnetic-field activity ( Hasan 2008 ) .

arxiv-2101-08650.title: AstroSat-CZTI as a hard X-ray Pulsar Monitor
arxiv-2101-08650.creator: Anusree, K.G. 1,*, Bhattacharya, D. 2, Rao, A.R. 2,5, Vadawale, S. 3, Bhalerao, V. 4, Vibhute, A. 2
arxiv-2101-08650.description: Abstract The Cadmium Zinc Telluride Imager (CZTI) is an imaging instrument onboard AstroSat. This instrument operates as a nearly open all-sky detector above 60 keV, making possible long integrations irrespective of the spacecraft pointing. We present a technique based on the AstroSat-CZTI data to explore the hard X-ray characteristics of the γ \gamma -ray pulsar population.

arxiv-2107-13832.title: Blind Room Parameter Estimation using Multiple Multichannel Speech Recordings
arxiv-2107-13832.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . Knowing the geometrical and acoustical parameters of a room may benefit applications such as audio augmented reality, speech dereverberation or audio forensics. In this paper, we study the problem of jointly estimating the total surface area, the volume, as well as the frequency-dependent reverberation time and mean surface absorption of a room in a blind fashion, based on two-channel noisy speech recordings from multiple, unknown source-receiver positions.

arxiv-2111-04297.title: ON THE STRUCTURE OF LAPLACE CHARACTERISTIC POLYNOMIAL FOR CIRCULANT FOLIATION
arxiv-2111-04297.creator: Y. S. Kwon, A. D. Mednykh, I. A. Mednykh

arxiv-2112-05226.title: Conditional Gaussian Nonlinear System: a Fast Preconditioner and a Cheap Surrogate Model For Complex Nonlinear Systems
arxiv-2112-05226.creator: Nan Chen, Yingda Li, Honghu Liu
arxiv-2112-05226.description: Abstract Developing suitable approximate models for analyzing and simulating complex nonlinear systems is practically important. This paper aims at exploring the skill of a rich class of nonlinear stochastic models, known as the conditional Gaussian nonlinear system (CGNS), as both a cheap surrogate model and a fast preconditioner for facilitating many computationally challenging tasks.

arxiv-2202-09864.title: Résolution du jeu de Juniper Green
arxiv-2202-09864.creator: Julien Lemoine
arxiv-2202-09864.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Julien Lemoine. Résumé

Dans cet article, nous décrivons la résolution du jeu de Juniper Green pour tout entier, avec des techniques suffisamment élémentaires pour être expliquées à des élèves maîtrisant les notions de diviseurs et multiples. Une méthode générale permet de résoudre le jeu pour presque tout entier, si bien qu’il ne reste qu’une petite cinquantaine de cas à traiter, chacun pouvant être résolu au prix d’une étude sur papier de quelques minutes.

arxiv-2205-15251.title: Virtual excitations and quantum correlations in ultra-strongly coupled harmonic oscillators under intrinsic decoherence
arxiv-2205-15251.creator: Radouan Hab-arrih, Ahmed Jellal, El Hassan El Kinani
arxiv-2205-15251.description: Abstract We study the intrinsic decoherence of coupled harmonic oscillators. The Milburn master equation is solved exactly, and the dynamics of virtual ground state excitations are investigated. The interaction of quantum correlations and virtual excitation was then studied. The following is a summary of our major findings. (i) The damped oscillatory profile of all three quantities is the same.

arxiv-2303-00809.title: Topological edge states in equidistant arrays of Lithium Niobate nano-waveguides
arxiv-2303-00809.creator: Andrey V. Gorbach, Jesper Beer, Anton Souslov
arxiv-2303-00809.description: Abstract We report that equidistant 1D arrays of thin-film Lithium Niobate nano-waveguides generically support topological edge states. Unlike conventional coupled-waveguide topological systems, the topological properties of these arrays are dictated by the interplay between intra- and inter-modal couplings of two families of guided modes with different parities.

arxiv-2307-09653.title: HAT-CL: A Hard-Attention-to-the-Task PyTorch Library for Continual Learning
arxiv-2307-09653.creator: Xiaotian Duan
arxiv-2307-09653.description: Abstract Catastrophic forgetting—the phenomenon in which a neural network loses previously obtained knowledge during the learning of new tasks—poses a significant challenge in continual learning. The Hard-Attention-to-the-Task (HAT) mechanism has shown potential in mitigating this problem, but its practical implementation has been complicated by issues of usability and compatibility, and a lack of support for existing network reuse.

arxiv-2401-09960.title: A Comprehensive Scalable Framework for Cloud-Native Pattern Detection with Enhanced Expressiveness Journal: XXX
arxiv-2401-09960.creator: Ioannis Mavroudopoulos, Anastasios Gounaris
arxiv-2401-09960.description: Abstract Detecting complex patterns in large volumes of event logs has diverse applications in various domains, such as business processes and fraud detection. Existing systems like ELK are commonly used to tackle this challenge, but their performance deteriorates for large patterns, while they suffer from limitations in terms of expressiveness and explanatory capabilities for their responses.

arxiv-2501-03729.title: Realistic Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2501-03729.creator: Maxime Zanella, Clément Fuchs *, Christophe De Vleeschouwer, Ismail Ben Ayed
arxiv-2501-03729.description: Abstract The zero-shot capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have been widely leveraged to improve predictive performance. However, previous works on transductive or test-time adaptation (TTA) often make strong assumptions about the data distribution, such as the presence of all classes.

arxiv-2504-16717.title: Random walks on random networks of cliques: Inferring the network structure
arxiv-2504-16717.creator: A Nannini, [ inst1 ] D H Zanette [ inst1 , inst2 ]
arxiv-2504-16717.description: Abstract \pipabstract We study the properties of discrete-time random walks on networks formed by randomly interconnected cliques, namely, random networks of cliques. Our purpose is to derive the parameters that define the network structure –specifically, the distribution of clique size and the abundance of inter-clique links– from the observation of selected statistical features along the random walk.

arxiv-2508-12450.title: Local Cluster Cardinality Estimation for Adaptive Mean Shift
arxiv-2508-12450.creator: Étienne Pepin ( etienne.pepin78@gmail.com)
arxiv-2508-12450.description: Abstract This article presents an adaptive mean shift algorithm designed for datasets with varying local scale and cluster cardinality. Local distance distributions, from a point to all others, are used to estimate the cardinality of the local cluster by identifying a local minimum in the density of the distance distribution.

arxiv-2511-04433.title: The TeV emission of 3C273: inverse Compton radiation from shear-accelerated high-energy electrons in the large-scale jet?
arxiv-2511-04433.creator: Fabrizio Tavecchio
arxiv-2511-04433.description: Abstract The VERITAS Collaboration recently reported the detection of very-high-energy (VHE) gamma-ray emission from the prototypical radio quasar 3C273. The temporal and the spectral properties of this component do not appear compatible with the extrapolation of the beamed blazar-like emission of the inner, pc-scale jet.

arxiv-2511-15844.title: Geant4 based library ”SCoRe4” for Surface Contamination and Roughness Effects simulations in rare event search experiments
arxiv-2511-15844.creator: Christoph Grüner
arxiv-2511-15844.description: Abstract Surface simulations are important for accurately modeling particle interactions in experiments where background contributions from surface contaminants can significantly affect detector performance. In rare event searches, such as dark matter or neutrinoless double beta decay experiments, standard Geant4 simulations typically assume perfectly smooth surfaces, neglecting the microscopic roughness that exists in real materials.

pmc-10641444.title: A walk on the wild side: A review of the epidemiology of Toxocara canis and Toxocara cati in wild hosts
pmc-10641444.creator: Celia V Holland
pmc-10641444.description: Toxocara species are cosmopolitan nematode parasites of companion, domestic and wild hosts. Of the 26 known species of Toxocara, only Toxocara canis and Toxocara cati are definitively zoonotic. The significance of wild carnivores as definitive hosts of T. canis and T. cati respectively, has received far less attention compared to domestic dogs and cats.

pmc-10671515.title: Amniotic Fluid and Placental Membranes as Sources of Stem Cells: Progress and Challenges 2.0
pmc-10671515.creator: Tullia Maraldi, Valentina Russo
pmc-10671515.description: . Since mounting evidence has demonstrated the efficacy of different sources of stem cells [1,2,3,4] and the derived secretome [5,6,7,8], in recent years, perinatal stem cells have been considered as an alternative and available cell source for biomedical research in vitro [9,10] and in vivo [11], including clinical trials [12,13,14].

pmc-11312165.title: Fermentation Performances and Aroma Contributions of Selected Non-Saccharomyces Yeasts for Cherry Wine Production
pmc-11312165.creator: Federico Bianchi, Michele Avesani, Marilinda Lorenzini, Giacomo Zapparoli, Barbara Simonato, Jose Antonio Couto
pmc-11312165.description: This study evaluates the fermentation performances of non-Saccharomyces strains in fermenting cherry must from Italian cherries unsuitable for selling and not intended to be consumed fresh, and their effects on the chemical composition of the resulting wine. Fermentation trials in 100 and 500 mL of must were carried out to select 21 strains belonging to 11 non-Saccharomyces species.

pmc-11425180.title: Mechanical and physical characteristics of concrete mixed with sugarcane bagasse ash and recycled polyethylene terephthalate
pmc-11425180.creator: Chukwuemeka Daniel, Richard Ocharo Onchiri, Benard Otieno Omondi
pmc-11425180.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The goal of this study was to produce sustainable concrete by reducing reliance on cement, which contributes to high carbon footprints, and natural sand, which is being depleted. Sugarcane bagasse ash (SCBA) was used to partially replace cement at 5 %, 10 %, and 15 %, while recycled polyethylene terephthalate (RPET) was used to partially replace sand at 5 %, 10 %, 15 %, and 20 %.

pmc-12402607.title: The Mediation of Circulating Inflammatory Proteins in the Causal Pathway From Immune Cells to Delirium
pmc-12402607.creator: Tongshuai Liu, Xia Bi, Fuguo Ma, Yanlin Chen
pmc-12402607.description: Objective:Observational research indicates that immune cells, in conjunction with circulating inflammatory proteins, could serve two functions in the development of delirium, despite the fact that the exact mechanisms remain ambiguous. The objective of this research is to identify the specific pathways through which immune cells trigger delirium and to evaluate the possible function of circulating inflammatory proteins as intermediaries.

pmc-12735460.title: Dietary Effects, Age, and Urban–Rural Dynamics in Shaping Gut Microbiota of Elderly Vietnamese: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12735460.creator: Adel Hamdi, Le Van Truong, Vu Thi Hien, Phuong Anh Nguyen, Thi Bach Duong Hoang, Charmaine Lloyd, Rajaraman Eri, Dragana Stanley, Dong Van Quyen, Thi Thu Hao Van, Miriam Fernandes, Carolina Dos Anjos, Denis Roy
pmc-12735460.description: Aging is associated with alterations in gut microbiota, yet the combined effects of geography and diet remain underexplored in elderly populations. This study investigated the gut microbiota of 227 healthy Vietnamese individuals aged ≥60 years, stratified by select urban and rural residence in both Hanoi and Thanh Hoa provinces, and across three age groups (60–69, 70–79, ≥80 years).

pmc-12745009.title: Total Tau protein as a novel biomarker for detection of neural injury following cardiopulmonary bypass in pediatric congenital heart surgery patients
pmc-12745009.creator: Marc J Lussier, Daniel J McKeone, Eric Scott Halstead, Allen R Kunselman, Jason R Imundo, John L Myers, Akif Ündar
pmc-12745009.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveTo investigate the association of Tau protein levels with postoperative evidence of neural injury following cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) in pediatric cardiac surgery patients.MethodsOne hundred forty-four consecutive pediatric cardiac surgery patients were recruited. Whole blood (3 mL) was collected in EDTA tubes from an arterial line at 5 time points: pre-midline incision, at 3 to 5 minutes on CPB, just prior to weaning from CPB, at 1 hour post-CPB, and at 24 hours post-CPB.

pmc-12890521.title: Loss of TRPV4 reduces pancreatic cancer growth and metastasis
pmc-12890521.creator: Joelle M-J Romac, Sandip M Swain, Nidula Mullappilly, Bandana Bindhani, Rodger A Liddle
pmc-12890521.description: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a rapidly metastasizing cancer characterized by a dense desmoplastic stroma composed of extracellular matrix (ECM) proteins, which complicates treatment. Upon stimulation, pancreatic stellate cells (PSCs) differentiated into cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) that are the source of ECM and cytokines in PDAC.

pmc-13392651.title: Springfield Healthy Hearts Data Framework: Protocol for a Co-Designed, City-Wide, Multicomponent Initiative That Coordinates, Monitors, and Evaluates Place-Based Heart Health Action
pmc-13392651.creator: Lauren Ball, Kirsten N Adlard, David Chua, Amy Kirkegaard, Genevieve N Healy, Sarah A McNaughton, Jason Ferris, Sonia Shah, George Thomas, Benjamin J Seligmann, Anne Bernard, Javad Sarvestan
pmc-13392651.description: BackgroundCardiovascular disease remains the leading global cause of mortality, driven by interrelated behavioral, biological, and psychosocial risk factors, despite the availability of effective prevention and treatment strategies. Persistent policy inertia, systemic fragmentation, and adverse social and commercial determinants have limited national responses. Addressing these gaps necessitates place-based, systems-oriented approaches that mobilize local assets, engage multisector stakeholders, and incorporate adaptive evaluation.

pmc-13539728.title: Structural and electrochemical properties of Mn-based DRX cathodes via metal composition control
pmc-13539728.creator: Hyeonji Jeong, Yeonwoo Kang, Sungjun Kwak, Dae Hong Jeong, Myeong Geun Cha, Ayeong Byeon
pmc-13539728.description: Cation-disordered rocksalt (DRX) cathodes consisting of redox-active and redox-inactive transition metals (TMs) have received much attention due to their high capacity, low cost and wide selection of TMs. Presently, few systematic studies have identified the effect of the ratio of the metal composition on the electrochemical performance of lithium-ion batteries.
